requested_scope: Study numeric over/under player props and other market families alongside original game forecast
research_limits: All listed numeric and binary markets are published-article archives captured after kickoff; no exact locked pregame quote-time proof
Quoted bookmaker source differs and lines vary; no retrospective line movement inference
No pregame prop side/probability forecast was committed, so do not compute an actual prediction hit rate
Handle/bet split share reflects bettor behavior, not probability
Anytime touchdown scored does not equal passing touchdowns thrown
First scorer requires verified chronological play-by-play, not boxscore alone
Quarter/half stats must be period matched; missing data are not zeros
Inactive and DNP settlements require book-specific terms
No full market coverage: defensive, kicker and alternate/combination markets not verified
Per-player props on one game are correlated, not independent trials
